Question Choices: Select which unit of time provides the most reasonable estimate for how long it takes to brush your teeth: ~~Seconds | Hours | Days~~
Hints: Compare the size or duration with familiar benchmarks, and choose the most reasonable of the offered options.
Solution: Tooth brushing takes about a few minutes, or roughly a hundred seconds. Of seconds, hours and days, seconds is the sensible option.

Question Choices: Select the most reasonable unit to describe the duration of a typical school lesson lasting less than an hour: ~~Seconds | Minutes | Hours~~
Hints: Compare the size or duration with familiar benchmarks, and choose the most reasonable of the offered options.
Solution: A lesson under one hour is conveniently described by its number of minutes.

Question Choices: Select which unit of time provides the most reasonable estimate for how long it takes for a tree to grow tall: ~~Seconds | Hours | Minutes | Years~~
Hints: Compare the size or duration with familiar benchmarks, and choose the most reasonable of the offered options.
Solution: A tree takes years to grow tall; seconds, minutes or hours are too short.

Question Choices: Fill: How much time has passed from 8:00 AM to 3:55 PM? ____ hours and ____ Minutes
Hints: Use 60 minutes per hour. Follow the time forward or backward and check the final clock reading.
Solution: Read 8:00 then 3:55. On the next forward occurrence within 12 hours, elapsed time = 475 minutes = 7 hours 55 minutes. Count whole hours, then remaining minutes.

Question Choices: Fill: How much time has passed from 10:45 AM to 1:00 PM? ____ hours and ____ Minutes
Hints: Use 60 minutes per hour. Follow the time forward or backward and check the final clock reading.
Solution: Read 10:45 then 1:00. On the next forward occurrence within 12 hours, elapsed time = 135 minutes = 2 hours 15 minutes. Count whole hours, then remaining minutes.
